subject: sci-dy
title: (R)SCI.DY.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 227 (T(IMP)M-25). SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), POL-DY (political dynamics) and POST (postulation). From COS-P: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From INFO-SOLD: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From POL-DY: ROTP (responsibility of the position) and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From ROTP: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From POST: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: LK-IMP (linkage implications).
